leadText:
Pokémon All-Stars are a series of DVDs that were released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) for .

Each single release contains a single disc with four episodes of about the Pokémon featured on the cover. The episodes are selected from the first 12 seasons. The box sets combined three single releases into one box set. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

They are similar to the series which was released in the United States by VIZ Media.
plainText:
Pokémon All-Stars are a series of DVDs that were released by (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) for .

Each single release contains a single disc with four episodes of about the Pokémon featured on the cover. The episodes are selected from the first 12 seasons. The box sets combined three single releases into one box set. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

They are similar to the series which was released in the United States by VIZ Media.

==Pokémon All-Stars: Triple Pack 1==
 
The Pokémon All-Stars: Triple Pack 1 is the first box set of Pokémon All-Stars series. Individual volumes were released in July 2010. The boxset was released in Australia on November 3, 2010 and in New Zealand on November 18, 2010 and its catalogue number is DBX13533.
 

==Pokémon All-Stars: Triple Pack 2==
 
The Pokémon All-Stars: Triple Pack 2 is the first box set of Pokémon All-Stars series. Individual volumes were released in September 2011 in Australia and New Zealand. The boxset was released in Australia on November 2, 2011 and its catalogue number is DBX13849.
 

==Pokémon: All Stars Gift Set==
The Pokémon: All Stars Gift Set was released by in Australia on May 1, 2015 and in New Zealand on May 27, 2015. Its catalogue number is BHE6075.

It contains Pokémon All-Stars: Pikachu, Pokémon All-Stars: Togepi, Pokémon All-Stars: Wobbuffet, Pokémon All-Stars: Totodile.
